rationale: Price has been grinding sideways in a very tight range (~$54.15–$54.35) for 14 candles since entry, but critically it remains above both the 9-EMA ($54.23) and the 5-min VWAP ($53.98), with the invalidation level at $53.75 unthreatened and maximum adverse excursion only -0.08%; the structure of higher lows within the consolidation (e.g., recent low $54.17–54.19 vs. earlier $54.04) is consistent with digestion rather than distribution. Volume has faded but not spiked on down candles, and with 132 minutes to close there is adequate time for a continuation move toward the $55.20 target before forcing a decision.
